questions.stem: A parser encounters 3 syntactic errors in a program. If it uses panic mode recovery and each error requires skipping an average of 5 tokens, how many tokens are skipped in total?
questions.explanation: In panic mode recovery, the parser skips tokens until a synchronizing token is found. If each error requires skipping 5 tokens, then 3 errors result in 3 * 5 = 15 tokens being skipped.

questions.stem: Explain why semantic errors can be more challenging to detect than syntactic errors.
markingGuide: Semantic errors involve the meaning of the code, which requires understanding the context.
